Leveraging our specialized expertise, we design and manufacture fully integrated, application-specific industrial motion systems that deliver value throughout the application lifecycle.

As demand for small satellites accelerates, Timken is investing in new efficiencies and working closely with leading manufacturers to enhance performance and quality. See how these advancements are solving real challenges for New Space innovators.
As a trusted design partner with a comprehensive advanced motion portfolio, we power the next generation of industrial performance.

Our newest Groenveld-BEKA automatic lubrication technology brings together advanced engineering and digitization to help customers reduce waste and extend equipment life. Learn more about how we deliver smarter, data-enabled performance for customers.
From strong communities to sustainable solutions, we focus on people, planet and products to build a more efficient world for generations to come.

Every R&D investment we make is focused on driving breakthroughs in advanced motion technology.

pages.raw_title: About Us, An Overview of a Strong Brand - The Timken Company
pages.raw_meta: Timken's growing portfolio of products and services help power industries from renewable energy to food production.
raw_blocks: A Trusted Advanced Motion Technologies Partner

The needs of our customers drive our innovations and solutions. We combine cutting-edge engineering with more than 125 years of specialized expertise to solve complex industrial motion challenges and advance strategic end markets worldwide. Our multinational footprint allows us to think globally but act locally, delivering the systems engineering and motion technology our customers need — where and when it matters most.

Our Timken R&D is driven by real-world challenges and emerging opportunities. We combine our expertise in materials science, friction management, and power transmission to develop and engineer motion technology solutions that enhance performance, reliability and efficiency across the application lifecycle.
See how we innovate to transform industries.

We engineer fully integrated systems for critical applications in strategic end markets, including aerospace and defense, power and electrification, and automation and industrial solutions to lead the next frontier of industrial motion.
Explore the markets we serve.
A Team of Problem Solvers

Our multinational team drives our innovations and customer success. With diverse perspectives and a culture that fosters collaboration, we design and manufacture the next generation of industrial motion solutions and systems, strengthen the communities where we live and work, and develop future leaders for our company and the manufacturing industry.
Discover how you can make an impact at Timken.
Our shared values define how we do business and treat others.
Wherever we do business, the wellbeing of our people is our priority.
As a trusted partner, we are transparent and do what’s right.
Our technologies, systems and solutions set the standard for mission-critical applications.
Our growth culture demands superior performance and relentless execution.
Our team of innovators collaborate to transform how the world moves.
